meta.title: Privacy Policy | Snug
meta.description: How Snug handles your data: the extension sends nothing anywhere, and this website runs no analytics scripts.

website.heading: This website
website.body: This website runs no analytics scripts and loads nothing from third parties. Visits are counted only from the web server's access log, where IP addresses are masked, and the log is read offline.
